decisions.reason: Hosting the landing page on a subdomain is compatible with preserving lotclip.com routing to the existing product, but it does not change any attribute or scope of that preservation Requirement.
The subdomain decision changes landing-page domain routing, not the Webflow platform, website deliverable, or phase-one build scope.
The hosting-domain choice does not change the required bottom-section image or its presentation scope.
The subdomain routing decision does not alter the hero visual's content, format, links, media layout, or mobile framing.
The landing page's hosting location does not change its approved visual style, brand inputs, design reference, or selected design option.
The source decision concerns domain routing and does not modify the contact-page copy or headline.
Hosting the website on a subdomain does not necessarily change the form's fields, recipients, intended submitters, follow-up behavior, or comment box.
